text: The Tung Shing Group About Us About Tung Shing Board of Directors History Divisions Garment industry equipment Hotel Real estate Integrated building solutions Other Opportunities Investment Employment News and Events Gallery Contact English English Tiếng Việt 繁體中文 About Us The Tung Shing Group Publish: 5/24/2018 Viewed: 25322 Tung Shing Group was established in Vietnam in the early 90s, the group is entrenched in Vietnam, with diverse business profile from real estate development to trading, and employing more than 1,800 staff . The Tung Shing Group is Vietnam’s leading distributor of industrial sewing machines, and the business has flourished with the country’s burgeoning garment and textile sectors at the very beginning. Our property portfolio includes the luxury residential complex Golden Westlake Executive Residences; commercial office building Tung Shing Square and hotels such as Hanoi Hotel, Lake Side Hotel etc. – of which we had recently acquired Eastin Grand Hotel Saigon. The group is also Vietnam’s sole distributor for Johnson Controls systems, and the building integrated business has shown significant growth in the past few years. Today, Tung Shing Sewing Machine Company Limited remains one of Hong Kong’s leading distributors of industrial sewing machines, while Vietnam's businesses had been expanding and diverted into different directions. The Tung Shing Group is always searching for opportunities to expand our businesses and we are seeking many projects that which may lead us to another level for years to come.
